I was impressed by their academic achievements and their desire to serve this great nation. Thank you to our board members for their time and https://t.co/qSyqreuXSy

In a win for the Air Capital of the World, @BellFlight  finished the first fuselage for the Army’s new MV-75 Cheyenne at its Wichita Assembly Center.

Congratulations to everyone in Wichita who helped build it, and I’m looking forward to seeing it fly. https://t.co/dJUTtQgOlo

Congratulations to @DrJeffColyer on his nomination to serve as U.S. Ambassador to the United Arab Emirates. He earned a master’s in international relations from Cambridge and served as a White House Fellow in foreign affairs under President Reagan. He will represent our country

Susan and I just learned of the passing of Ed Bolen, a champion for American aviation. Ed grew up in Kansas and spent more than 40 years devoted to aerospace.

Early in his career he worked for Sen. Nancy Kassebaum and helped advance legislation that allowed aviation manufacturing to thrive, innovate, and lead. He later led GAMA, served at the FAA, and spent nearly 25 years leading NBAA.

Ed was inducted into the Kansas Aviation Hall of Fame earlier this week. Our prayers are with Beth, Jack, Robert and the rest of the Bolen family. May he rest in peace.
Congratulations to Ed Bolen on his induction into the Kansas Aviation Hall of Fame. A well-earned honor for a Kansan who has given his career to aviation. https://t.co/atUgtw9cgr

Kansas received $225,896,117 in rural health funding from Republicans’ Rural Health Transformation Program. This is the 6th highest award of all states for the second year in a row, and about $4 million more than last year.

The program was established by the Working Families Tax Cuts. I was proud to be part of the conversations that put these investments in the bill, and I’m glad to see Kansas hospitals getting another round.
https://t.co/7VwE0Wj8T5

Today, we honor those who have sacrificed for our freedom and pray for those still serving. Thank you to the countless Kansans and their families who have answered the call to serve this great nation. https://t.co/oHTp4Kn22o

Congratulations to @Jim_Jordan on his election as Republican Leader. He is a strong conservative who will fight for this country and hold Washington accountable. I look forward to working with him on behalf of Kansas taxpayers, workers and families.
Happy 251st birthday to the brave men and women of the U.S. Marine Corps. Thank you for always fighting for our freedom. @USMC https://t.co/phYEW980jI

Good news for Kansas ranchers: @USDA has awarded $616,280 to three meat processors in the 4th District.

Stroot’s in Goddard and Mulvane, T & W Meat Co. in Kingman and Walnut Valley Packing in El Dorado are each receiving funds to buy new equipment to handle more livestock.

November is National Aviation History Month, and I’m proud to represent the Air Capital of the World.

Recently I was at McConnell Air Force Base for the Frontiers in Flight open house and airshow to watch the Thunderbirds fly. About 100,000 people came out over the two days. It https://t.co/3u54hHeBrE

The VA is reaching veterans who never enrolled in VA health care, and claims hit a record 3.15 million last fiscal year. They're now hiring more than 2,000 people to help process them and get veterans their benefits.

I'm glad to see @SecVetAffairs putting more staff behind the

It was great to have @SBA_Kelly and @SecretaryBurgum  in Wichita Tuesday. We stopped at Greater Grounds Coffee downtown and visited with Byron. He opened the shop after serving in the Navy. Later we toured Leading Technology Composites, where Kansans make the body armor and ballistic shields that protect our troops and law enforcement.

We discussed Republicans’ Working Families Tax Cuts and what they mean for Kansas small businesses and manufacturers. #WheresRon

EPA’s proposed rewrite of the Biden administration’s 2024 methane rule is a major win for Kansas oil and gas producers and American energy independence. That rule treated a Kansas family producing a few barrels a day like a major oil company. The new proposal would set separate standards for low-producing wells. I applaud President Trump and @epaleezeldin, and I’m cosponsoring legislation to put that fix into law.

https://t.co/kp608v8Mpi

Happy National First Responders Day to the police officers, firefighters, paramedics and EMTs across the 4th District. You are the first on the scene when Kansans need help. Our communities are safer because of you. https://t.co/XXDb902GJS

Spirit Defense announced Friday that it will be a manufacturing partner on General Atomics’ new FQ-42 Vengeance Collaborative Combat Aircraft, with the work done here in Wichita. It was great to join them for the ribbon cutting. Keeping defense programs like this in American factories is how we protect our supply chains. #WheresRon
I will always defend life, families and the freedom to live out your faith. Honored to earn an A+ on @CWforA’s congressional scorecard. https://t.co/TZhsQ5Arfh

I had the opportunity to fly on a KC-135 at McConnell Air Force Base as the 22nd Air Refueling Wing prepares to close out more than five decades with this tanker. The first KC-135 flew in 1956, and more than 350 are still in the air today. The 22nd is the only wing flying both the KC-135 and the KC-46 until the transition finishes in 2027. Thank you to the airmen who have kept these aircraft ready far longer than anyone expected. #WheresRon

This week I joined VA Secretary Doug Collins for a roundtable at Passageways in Wichita, which works to reduce veteran homelessness in south central Kansas. The VA helped nearly 52,000 homeless veterans find permanent housing last year. That’s the most in seven years.

Kansas https://t.co/TCy6ncbIV7

I applaud President Trump and @SecRollins for $8 billion in Harvest Fuel Relief. It will help Kansas farmers who have kept feeding America and the world through higher diesel costs.

conflicts.method: Each itemized donor dollar is counted once, under the industry of the donor's self-reported employer; an industry counts if at least one LD-2 client in it lobbied on any bill this member sponsored or voted on.
